1. (Currently Amended) An assembly comprising a test tube with an affixed MTP, __wherein the MTP comprises a unique identifier that is readable by an external reader without direct contact with the MTP__.

2. (Currently Amended) The assembly of claim 1, wherein the MTP is embedded in the test tube __and the test tube comprises a transparent window aligned with the MTP for optical reading__.

3. (Currently Amended) The assembly of claim 1, wherein the MTP is embedded underneath __the bottom of the test tube__, oriented for reading downwards.

4. (Currently Amended) The assembly of claim 1, wherein the test tube is a biorepository test tube __configured for cryogenic sample storage__.

5. (Previously presented) The assembly claim 1, wherein the MTP is embedded in polypropylene or acetal polymer.

6. (Currently Amended) The assembly of claim 1, wherein the MTP is embedded near the center bottom of the __test tube__.

14. (Previously presented) The system of claim 13 adapted for low temperature operation, such that the racks/test tubes are handled at -20 C or less.
